description:
Corporate / Executive Driver

Location: Bucharest
Employment Type: 2-year temporary contract through Randstad for Philip Morris Romania

We are looking for a highly professional and reliable Executive Driver to provide dedicated transportation support to a senior business leader. This role requires exceptional driving skills, professionalism, discretion, flexibility, and the ability to maintain the highest standards of service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide safe, comfortable, and punctual transportation to and from business meetings, events, appointments, the office, and other locations.
  • Plan routes efficiently, considering traffic conditions and schedule changes.
  • Ensure the vehicle is maintained in excellent condition, including cleanliness, routine inspections, servicing, and fuel management.
  • Anticipate transportation needs and proactively coordinate schedules when required.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding business activities, travel plans, and sensitive information.
  • Represent the company professionally at all times and ensure a high standard of customer service.
  • Support ad-hoc transportation requirements, including occasional travel outside Bucharest when needed.

Requirements

  • Valid driving license with an excellent driving record.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience as an Executive Driver, Corporate Driver, or Personal Driver supporting senior executives, directors, board members.
  • Proven experience providing transportation services in a corporate environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Bucharest roads, traffic patterns, and route planning.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Flexibility regarding working hours and schedule adjustments.
  • Customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Intermediate English level (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multinational organizations or senior international executives.
  • Defensive driving training or advanced driving certifications.
  • Experience coordinating executive travel schedules and logistics.

What We Offer

  • Meal tickets 40 RON/day.
  • Holiday vouchers 3,450 RON gross/year.
  • Easter and Christmas gift vouchers 1,600 RON gross each occasion.
  • Christmas gift for employees' children (0-18 years old): 300 RON gross.
  • Medical services.
  • Life & accident insurance.
